title: HSBC India Composite PMI (July 2026): Manufacturing at 53.5 & Services at 53.3
summary: High-frequency survey indicator reflecting health of India's manufacturing and services output.

blocks.content: High-frequency survey indicator reflecting health of India's manufacturing and services output.

items: HSBC India Manufacturing PMI registered **53.5 in July 2026** (above 50 signals manufacturing expansion).
HSBC India Services PMI Business Activity Index stood at **53.3 in July 2026** (down from 57.4 in June).

blocks.summary: Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) is compiled by S&P Global; PMI score > 50 indicates expansion, while < 50 indicates contraction.
